items.title: RBI Maintains Stance on Repo Rate to Balance Growth and Inflation
items.gs_paper: GS Paper III (Indian Economy and Issues Relating to Planning, Mobilization of Resources)
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) decided to keep the benchmark repo rate unchanged, emphasizing a disciplined approach to bring retail inflation down to the 4% target while sustaining economic momentum.
items.key_takeaway: Focus on consumer price index (CPI), food inflation volatility, monetary transmission mechanisms, and macro-economic stability.

items.title: India Expands Ramsar Network with New Wetland Sites
items.gs_paper: GS Paper III (Conservation, Environmental Pollution and Degradation)
items.summary: The Union Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change has added new wetlands of international importance to the Ramsar list, bolstering India's efforts toward ecosystem restoration and biodiversity conservation.
items.key_takeaway: Understand the criteria under the Ramsar Convention, the role of wise use of wetlands, and related domestic legal protections like the Wetland (Conservation and Management) Rules.

items.title: Supreme Court Reaffirms the Scope of Article 142 on Complete Justice
items.gs_paper: GS Paper II (Indian Constitution - Historical Underpinnings, Evolution, Features, Amendments, and Provisions)
items.summary: The Supreme Court reiterated that its extraordinary powers under Article 142 cannot be used to bypass express statutory provisions, outlining the delicate balance between judicial discretion and statutory law.
items.key_takeaway: Analyze judicial activism vs. judicial restraint, constitutional limits of Article 142, and key precedents governing inherent powers of the judiciary.

items.title: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) Gains Strategic Momentum
items.gs_paper: GS Paper II (Bilateral, Regional and Global Groupings and Agreements involving India)
items.summary: Diplomatic discussions highlighted the operationalization of logistics routes and green hydrogen pipelines under the IMEC initiative, aimed at improving connectivity between Asia, the Arabian Gulf, and Europe.
items.key_takeaway: Evaluate strategic implications for India's trade, alternative routes to BRI (Belt and Road Initiative), and maritime logistics infrastructure.

items.title: Indigenous Development of High-Altitude UAVs under iDEX
items.gs_paper: GS Paper III (Indigenization of Technology and Developing New Technology, Security Challenges)
items.summary: The Ministry of Defence awarded contracts to domestic start-ups under the Innovations for Defence Excellence (iDEX) framework to manufacture high-altitude long-endurance (HALE) unmanned aerial vehicles.
items.key_takeaway: Study the role of public-private partnerships in defense sector self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat), technology transfer, and border security enhancement.
